questions.question:
What would be the effect of the following UPDATE statement? Assume Products is a table
containing multiple records.

UPDATE Products SET ProductName = 'My Favorite Product'
WHERE CategoryID = 1;
options: The statement updates all rows to have ProductName value My Favorite Product.

The statement updates any rows to have ProductName value My Favorite Product if
the CategoryID is not 1.

The statement updates any rows to have ProductName value My Favorite Product if
the CategoryID is 1.

The statement updates rows whose ProductName is already My Favorite Product to
have a CategoryID with value 1.

questions.question:
What would be the effect of the following DELETE statement? Assume Products is a table
containing multiple records and with a foreign key to table Categories.

DELETE FROM Products
WHERE CategoryID IN
(SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories
WHERE Categories.CategoryName = 'Electronics');
options:
The statement removes all rows in the Products table that correspond to a Categories
row whose CategoryName is Electronics.

The statement removes all rows from the Products table that contains a non-NULL
CategoryID.

The statement would error due to the DELETE and WHERE keywords not being
allowed to be used in combination.

The statement removes all rows from the Products table corresponding to a
Categories row whose CategoryName is Electronics, while also removing the rows
from Categories with CategoryName Electronics.
